subject: HANDOFF ticket09: late INNER is trigger + wake + presentation; preserve cover bridge, move trusted wake earlier
body: READY_FOR_MANAGER_REVIEW. User symptom reproduced in source/field evidence. Root hierarchy: (1) trigger often delayed to coarse ~90deg (largest), (2) current source intentionally starts cover opening visual before async INNER wake completes (~155-160 ms visual lead), (3) wake ACK is not useful pixels; clean historical cycles show ~89.7 ms post-handoff inner surface attachment, (4) onEarlyOpeningEdge is coupled to renderOwnershipArmed and can be discarded during cold/admission. Recommended direction: independent generation-fenced trusted wake ingress, dedicated bounded wake dispatch/receipts, non-authoritative render/surface prewarm while wake runs, and exact-current first-useful presentation gate for cover-bridge retirement. No production writes. Physical Fold7 A/B remains mandatory.
